# Migbits motion pack Six Motion Primitives-derived components (MIT). Preserve components/motion/LICENSE and ORIGIN.json. The shared class helper carries the shadcn/ui MIT notice under components/ui/LICENSE. Dependency notices are included in licenses/. Original Migbits application resources are not relicensed by this pack. ## Install Merge the listed package.json dependencies into a React + TypeScript project configured with Tailwind CSS v4. Keep components/, lib/, and styles/ together in their relative layout. Import styles/globals.css once. Import MotionExamples from example.tsx to see the same six examples as the website. The examples import their own scoped CSS. No Next.js or backend is required. ## Individual components import { TextLoop } from './components/motion/text-loop'; {[thoughtful, playful]} All six primitives accept paused. The shared policy respects reduced motion and page visibility. The gallery pauses offscreen previews using useInView; callers should do the same for decorative offscreen effects. Use native buttons with Magnetic. AnimatedBackground supports controlled value/onValueChange; its defaultValue is initialization-only. Hover-only use requires an equivalent keyboard interaction in the host. TransitionPanel clamps invalid indexes. ## Scope Examples are local interactions. TextLoop's decorative rotating words have a static screen-reader alternative in the example. Static content remains available when animation is paused or reduced motion is enabled. CSS motion-path support is required for BorderTrail; without it the surrounding card remains usable. Browser/assistive-technology evidence is recorded in the project validation log, not guaranteed by an upstream license. Pinned source: https://github.com/ibelick/motion-primitives/tree/120f64f6ca60348e251f929e9c81f11ccbe45eda Source hashes, modifications and notices are bundled with the pack.
